## Change
What problem does this solve? Link the issue and explain the resulting behavior.

## Validation
Commands run and relevant TV/phone checks. Identify anything not tested.

## Story independence
Can another story use this without editing the engine? Note any package contract changes.

## Coordination
Mention overlapping work, data compatibility, and any deployment/configuration changes.

Owner, base branch and prerequisite PRs (or none). Which shared files/interfaces might another task touch? State the intended merge order for dependent PRs.

## Handoff
For work in progress: what remains, next safe step, and any unpushed/local-only work. State whether this is pushed only, merged, or deployed; do not equate these states. Update this section when ready for review.

Checkpoint commit and integration assessment: ready to merge, or the exact outstanding review/check/dependency/migration. Reassess when the user accepts the result or moves to another step.
